curation_method: Source-table transcription and byte-preserved official NASA PSI CSV; source files independently downloaded and SHA256 verified. No source PDFs or temporary signed URLs are bundled.

datasets.title: An Experimental Study of Opposed Flow Diffusion Flame Extinction Over a Thin Fuel in Microgravity
datasets.license: Work of the US Gov. Public Use Permitted. (NTRS metadata)

scope.material_description: 99 percent cellulose / 1 percent polyamide resin laboratory wipes
scope.flow_direction: opposed relative flow from moving fuel through quiescent oxidizer

limitations: Only13 test conditions and one thin cellulosic fuel; cannot validate predictions across five materials or pressure variation.
Two rates are left-censored and must not be replaced with zero or arbitrary positive values.
No extinction within a5.18-second window is right-censored survival, not evidence of indefinite sustained burning.
The report states four extinctions overall but Table I lists three; do not invent the omitted fourth row.
Table I lacks original run IDs; derived row IDs should remain explicitly labelled and their experimental independence discussed.
Use nominal environmental fuel speed; flame-relative velocity adds measured flame propagation and would leak target information.
All training rows share experiment_id and campaign NASA-CR-182185; row-level random splits would overstate independent evidence.

field_provenance.o2_percent: Table I PDF page7, measured oxygen mole percent; Appendix PDF page15 states approximately +/-0.1 percentage-point uncertainty.
field_provenance.flow_cm_s: Table I fuel speed, moving sample through quiescent oxidizer; equals free-stream opposed speed relative to sample. Do not use characteristic velocity, which includes flame speed.
field_provenance.spread_rate_mm_s: Table I spread rate cm/sec multiplied by10; rate is a time-average and Appendix PDF page15 reports measurement errors from0.08 to0.15cm/sec.
field_provenance.thickness_mm: PDF page3 states half-thickness0.0038cm, so full thickness=2*.0038*10=.076mm.
field_provenance.pressure_kpa: Appendix PDF page15 states chamber filled with oxygen then nitrogen to1atm; exact conversion1atm=101.325kPa.
field_provenance.ignited: Procedures and Results describe ignited flames in all13 conditions; Table I extinction column refers to post-ignition extinction.
field_provenance.gravity: PDF page3 describes NASA Lewis5.18-second free fall, not normal gravity. Numericgravity_g=0 would be a microgravity idealization rather than a measured exact zero.

datasets.title: Burning and Suppression of Solids-II (BASS-II): official experiment catalogue

scope.materials_and_geometries: Thin/thick PMMA sheets, PMMA rods, Nomex III, wax candle, SIBAL fabric and sphere; not all have opposed flow.
scope.raw_field_policy: Preserve original CSV headers, string values and missing cells without target inference.

limitations: Official matrix does not contain spread rate, explicit extinction labels, flow direction, or pressure columns. ReadMe defines geometries by PI. Many Air display values are time-varying strings; reading response time is about1minute. Do not silently cast fan voltage or multi-flow strings to physical speeds.
Fan display records fan voltage times ten or potentiometer settings, not a calibrated flow velocity.
Air display is a duct-speed cm/s indicator with about one-minute response time; multi-stage strings are not single numerical conditions.
Initial/final calibrated oxygen values do not establish stage-specific oxygen.
Rows include opposed, concurrent and stagnation geometries; PI-specific definitions are in the official ReadMe.
No complete spread-rate and ignition/extinction targets are supplied by this catalogue; zero training rows are inferred.

datasets.title: Burning and Suppression of Solids-II (BASS-II) Summary Report: tabulated evidence
datasets.license: Use by or on behalf of the US Gov. Permitted. (NTRS metadata)

scope.oxygen_policy: Stage oxygen remains null; initial/final intervals are retained without invented interpolation.

limitations: Table 5.1 initial/final oxygen does not identify oxygen at each flow stage. Stage oxygen is unknown, not automatically the initial value.
Table 5.1 has one/two-sided burning and width dependence; preserve these covariates and do not treat all as equivalent to the thermally thin model.
Table 5.1 does not explicitly state per-stage measured pressure; pressure_kpa left null.
Positive reported spread-rate stage is a direct observation; do not manufacture separate extinguished/nonignition rows from test termination.
Thin PMMA Table2.1 has two aggregate boundary estimates, not two full datasets or multiple independent groups.
Figures 2.11/2.12 are computation, not experimental measurements.
Table 7.1 SIBAL is concurrent flow, incompatible with the present opposed-flow model without explicit direction-aware handling.
